item.title: Redis Core Practice (Part 1): Service Deployment, Security Hardening, and Persistence Mechanisms
item.description: Part 1 of the Redis Core Practice series: Systematically reviews Redis cache service positioning and comprehensive comparison with Memcached/Tair, provides step-by-step guidance on source compilation and installation, environment variables, and multi-instance planning under Linux, deeply analyzes the protected-mode mechanism and bind/requirepass security hardening, and details the underlying principles and trade-offs of RDB snapshots and AOF append logs.
